scope: Current Agent output requirements and facts needed to map a real model through ModelAdapter; this is not a frozen production contract.

defect_probability: Whether this means the calibrated probability of at least one defect in the image
Value range, calibration method, and behavior for defect-free samples
model_owner_confirmation_required.detection_confidence: Meaning, scope, and calibration of the per-defect score
model_owner_confirmation_required.class_confidence: Meaning, scope, and calibration of the per-defect class score
model_owner_confirmation_required.severity: Supported labels and their mapping to the Agent's four labels
model_owner_confirmation_required.severity_probabilities: Whether a full four-label distribution is available and whether values sum to one
model_owner_confirmation_required.severity_confidence: Definition and relation to the severity probability distribution
model_owner_confirmation_required.bbox_xyxy: Coordinate origin, order, units, and image dimensions
model_owner_confirmation_required.mask_ref: Availability, format, storage, and authorized access method
model_owner_confirmation_required.metadata: Availability and format of model_version, calibration_version, and inference_timestamp
model_owner_confirmation_required.error: Native failure response shape, error codes, and timeout behavior
